basic_profile.bio: I'm an avid gamer living in Missoula, Montana. I spend most of my free time playing Wild Rift, particularly maining Aurelion Sol. I love discussing strategies and sharing game experiences on Reddit. During the day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me the flexibility to game into the late hours. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to focus on my hobbies. I'm usually online in the evenings and late at night.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise mainly lies in mobile gaming, especially Wild Rift. I've been playing since its release and have climbed the ranks through trial and error. I also have a keen interest in tech, which I continuously explore through online courses and forums. My graphic design skills are self-taught, honed over years of practice and client work.
